_meta.metric: share of population with unimproved or no basic water service
_meta.unit: share 0-1, mean of unimproved drinking water and unimproved sanitation
_meta.citation: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 baseline annual water risk indicators (doi:10.46830/writn.23.00061), indicators udw and usa. Creative Commons.
_meta.why: a provision measure rather than a geography measure: it describes what a place has built
_meta.spatialUnit: union of HydroBASINS level-6, GADM level-1 and groundwater aquifers; point-in-polygon, no name matching
_meta.combination: mean of udw and usa, registered as ONE Ground Floor dimension so water does not silently take half the weight of the median
_meta.excluded: ucw untreated wastewater was a candidate and was EXCLUDED: measured 0 of 206 countries with more than one distinct value, i.e. country-level. bws water stress excluded as rainfall-driven.
